name: Roma
long_description:
Roma is the task app where AI gets to work for you. Simply type or say anything - an idea, a thought, a bunch of different things you need to remember - and Roma starts the work from your pocket.

It's connected to your calendar, your email, your files, so it knows what to do next before you even ask.
one_liner: The AI task app that gets to work for you.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Currently Co-Founder of Roma (F26). Previously Co-Founder of Senic (YC S13), acquired by GIRA. Programmer and designer. 3x Red Dot Award winner. Passionate long-distance runner. Love to sketch. https://www.tobiaseichenwald.com/

founders.title: Founder/.
founders.founder_bio: Building something new at YC (F26). Writer, director, and entrepreneur with nearly two decades of experience in brand marketing and creative. Previously agency creative at Goodby Silverstein & Partners and 72andSunny, in-house director at Dropbox, and co-founder of The Goondocks, an award-winning creative studio.
